definitions.explanation: The dark outline or shape of something seen against a lighter background. Also used in fashion to describe the overall shape or line of a garment or outfit.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}にシルエットが{浮|う}かぶ。
examples.english: A silhouette stands out against the sunset.

examples.japanese: すっきりしたシルエットのドレス。
examples.english: A dress with a clean silhouette.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{稜線|りょうせん}が{美|うつく}しいシルエットを{描|えが}いていた。
examples.english: The mountain ridgeline traced a beautiful silhouette.

notes: From French 'silhouette.' In fashion, describes the overall shape of clothing: Aラインシルエット (A-line silhouette), タイトシルエット (tight/slim silhouette). Common collocations: シルエットが{浮|う}かぶ (a silhouette appears), シルエットを{描|えが}く (to trace a silhouette), {美|うつく}しいシルエット (a beautiful silhouette/outline).
